content:
anya: Quick alert: console shows a negative provisional (-9) after a preemptive router swap during a streaming session. Customer submitted support ticket.
matt: can you paste logs?
anya: logs attached:
```
2026-07-05T04:12:41Z router: session=abc-77 route=us-east-1 -> us-central-1 reason=preemptive_rebalance
2026-07-05T04:12:41Z runtime: session=abc-77 prefix=23 tokens_emitted=35 status=streaming
2026-07-05T04:12:42Z runtime: session=abc-77 toolcall=image_caption truncated=true tokens_tool=9
2026-07-05T04:12:43Z billing: session=abc-77 provisional_credit=+0 owner=us-east-1
2026-07-05T04:12:44Z billing: session=abc-77 reconcile_adjust=-9 owner=us-central-1
```
roshan: provisional write shows +0? looks like provisional fast-path skipped then reconcile subtracted 9 on new owner. mismatch.
priya: likely because provisional fast-path is skipped when runtime detects truncation and defers to reconcile; router handoff changed owner before reconcile ran. ledger writes use owner as shard key.
dana: so origin shows no provisional but final ledger sees reconcile adjust with no matching provisional -> negative delta. console shows negative on final owner which confuses customers.
matt: we should preserve an orig_owner provenance id even when provisional skipped. then reconcile can look up a provisional placeholder or annotate the reconcile event with provenance to avoid orphan negatives.
roshan: ledger change: allow reconcile to create provisional placeholder if none exists but tag with prov_id so we can atomically transfer ownership later. low risk.
priya: UI tweak: if reconcile creates negative and there is no provisional, surface a help badge "pending provenance lookup" and link to trace. suppress auto-refund until provenance resolved.
anya: ops-bot created INC-2026-410 assigned eng-platform. :triangular_flag_on_post:
ops-bot: suggested rollout: add X-Orig-Owner in router handoff, runtime to emit prov_id on truncated toolcalls, ledger to accept reconcile-create-with-prov (canary 5%).
dana: tests: simulate truncated toolcall with immediate preemptive rebalance. verify reconcile either finds provisional or creates placeholder and no customer-visible negative.
matt: plan: router + runtime + ledger changes ~3d total if we parallelize. I'll open PRs and link tests.
anya: short-term band-aid: console hides single-session negatives < 10 tokens for 24h and adds link to "pending reconciliation"; I'll file the quick UI PR.
ops-bot: INC-2026-410 status: investigating.
